title: Kevin Sam (digital health pharmacist & product manager) weeks after the audiobook — 'this question keeps popping into my head on the drive to and from work'
summary: Sam is a product manager working in digital health as a pharmacist and health informatician. He listened to the audiobook and posted the question it left him with about his own workplace, along with four ideas he is carrying into practice: governance that holds when short-term urgency hits, incentives that reward real-world impact over short-term output, standards shared openly, and what he calls mission gravity, where defaults make the right thing the easiest path. He adds that his own work sits outside private-market pressure, and the long game is hard to hold regardless.
blockquote:
"What more can I try to nurture a work environment truly anchored in data-driven healthcare and human flourishing?"
Weeks after finishing the audiobook for Eric Ries's Incorruptible, this question keeps popping into my head on the drive to and from work.
